up: List the first 1000 rows (order by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id) of activities that have IC50 activity with a pChEMBL value, for the target CHEMBL1902 (Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase FKBP1A, human single-protein target). Include the following columns: assay_chembl_id (from assays.chembl_id), target_type (from target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (from target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.molecule_chembl_id), standard_type (from activities.standard_type), pChEMBL value (from activities.pchembl_value). The activities must be linked to the target via target_dictionary.tid = activities.tid (or ass.tid = activities.tid then target_dictionary.tid = ass.tid). Only consider assays where target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1902' (human) and target_dictionary.target_type is 'SINGLE PROTEIN'. Ensure the activity type is IC50 by checking standard_type = 'IC50' (no further unit or relation filters). Order the result set by molecule_chembl_id ascending, then assay_chembl_id ascending, and limit the output to the first 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value, t.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.molecule_chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1902'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.molecule_chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
